#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::vector<int> alice_choices(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> alice_choices[i];
    }
    std::vector<int> bob_choices(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> bob_choices[i];
    }

    // Rotate bob_choices by one position
    int first_bob_choice = bob_choices[0];
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        bob_choices[i] = bob_choices[i + 1];
    }
    bob_choices[n - 1] = first_bob_choice;

    int min_wins = 0, max_wins = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        min_wins += std::min(alice_choices[i], bob_choices[i]);
    }

    int max_bob = *std::max(bob_choices);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (bob_choices[i] == max_bob && (bob_choices[i] + alice_choices[i]) > min_wins) {
            min_wins = bob_choices[i] + alice_choices[i];
        }
    }

    int max_alice = *std::max(alice_choices);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (alice_choices[i] == max_alice && (alice_choices[i] + bob_choices[i]) > min_wins) {
            min_wins = alice_choices[i] + bob_choices[i];
        }
    }

    if (min_wins > n) {
        min_wins -= n;
    } else {
        min_wins = 0;
    }

    std::cout << min_wins << " " << max_wins << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
